title: catscan known findings file (known_schema 1)
description: Approved known findings: written by catscan results known, applied by --known. A finding matches a row by its key (no box); a key found more often than its count makes every finding of the key new. New fields may be added in minor versions; readers refuse a newer known_schema or key_algo.

key_algo.description: The identity-text rule rows were keyed with: NFKC, case-folded, clock times and digit runs as #, punctuation dropped, U+0300-U+036F combining marks removed, whitespace collapsed.

catscan.description: The catscan version that last wrote the file.

axes.description: The cell axes the rows were approved with; a run on other axes warns known-scope-differs.

reader.description: The approving runs' engine, Vision revision and macOS major; null when they were mixed.

scope.description: Per command, the flags of the approving run that decide which findings exist, and the sha256 of its --allow file (null when none or unreadable).

findings.description: One row per key, sorted by every field.

text_size.description: The text size when it is not default; absent for default, which rows approved before the axis match.

screen.description: From the layout; null when the cell is the input path.

path.description: The input path when no layout mapped it; else null.

rule.description: The finding registry rule (reason, signal, evidence, rule or field); null when the kind has none.

text.description: Normalized identity text; null when the kind has none (pseudo-not-applied).
